meta.title: AutoNexa | Car dealership management software
meta.description: AutoNexa runs your used car dealership from one system: buying, stock, pricing, bookings, sales and profit on every car. In English and Arabic.

opening.title: Run your whole car dealership from one screen.
opening.lede: AutoNexa is software for used car dealerships. Track every car from purchase to sale, see what each one earns, and give your whole team one place to work.
opening.caption: Buying · Stock · Bookings · Profit
opening.place: Made for dealerships in the UAE
opening.alt: The AutoNexa dashboard: this month's sales, new and active bookings, money still to collect, and sales by month
opening.claim: Open it in the morning and see what is in stock, what is booked, what is owed and what you made.

features.caption: What it does
features.title: Every part of the sale, in one system.
features.intro: Most dealerships keep these in separate spreadsheets and group chats. In AutoNexa they share one record for each car, so a change in one place shows up everywhere.

rows.name: Stock control
rows.lead: Every car, its status, location and price, always up to date.
rows.text: Add a car once, choosing the make and model from a ready catalog. See at a glance how much of your stock is in transit, ready for sale, booked or sold, and filter by status, branch or model.
rows.alt: The inventory screen with the stock pipeline and a list of cars, their status, location and price

rows.name: Bookings and sales
rows.lead: Reserve a car, take a deposit and always know when payment is due.
rows.text: Set your deposit and full-payment deadlines. AutoNexa shows what is paid and what is left to collect, flags bookings that need attention, and cancels holds with no deposit unless a manager agrees to keep them.
rows.alt: The bookings screen showing what each customer has paid, what is left to collect and when it is due

rows.name: Buying and costs
rows.lead: Record each purchase and keep every cost on the car.
rows.text: Each purchase keeps its price, source and every expense, from shipping to customs and inspection. You know a car's true cost before you set a price.
rows.alt: A car's purchase record with its price, total cost and where the cost comes from

rows.name: Pricing and profit
rows.lead: Set a minimum, target and advertised price, and see the profit first.
rows.text: One line shows the car's cost, minimum price, discount room and asking price. Selling below the minimum needs a manager, and every price change is kept with who made it.
rows.alt: A car's pricing screen with total cost, minimum and target price, expected profit and the price corridor

rows.name: Customers
rows.lead: Every buyer, with their bookings and their sales executive.
rows.text: Call, WhatsApp or email a customer in one tap. See who is buying right now, who joined this month and who has not booked yet, and book them a car from their card.
rows.alt: Customer cards with phone, email, sales executive and number of bookings

profit.caption: Profit
profit.title: See what each car really makes.
profit.body: AutoNexa takes the selling price and subtracts the purchase and every recorded cost, so profit is worked out for you, car by car. Set a minimum price and anything below it stops for a manager’s approval.
profit.flag: Below minimum price: needs manager approval
profit.foot: Sample figures, to show how the screen works.

more.caption: Everything around the sale
more.title: The rest of the dealership is in here too.

items.name: Your own website
items.desc: Publish your stock to a dealership website on your own address. Buyers search and save cars, and their enquiries come straight into AutoNexa.
items.alt: A dealership website with a car search and featured cars

items.name: Share a car with one link
items.desc: Send a buyer a page with the car's photos, details and price, straight to WhatsApp. They don't need an account, and costs are never shown.
items.alt: The share dialog with a link for the customer and a WhatsApp button

items.name: Staff documents
items.desc: Each person keeps their Emirates ID, visa, licence and contract in one private place, and you see what is about to expire.
items.alt: Staff documents with their expiry dates and a warning for those expiring soon

items.name: The right access for each person
items.desc: Give each person a role and branch, so they see and do only what their job needs. Invite new staff by email.
items.alt: The users screen with each person's role, status and last sign-in

items.name: Alerts that find you
items.desc: New bookings, overdue payments, cars ready for sale and requests to approve reach the right people, in the app and on their phone.
items.alt: Notifications about a new booking, an overdue payment, a request to approve and a car ready for sale

items.name: The full history of every car
items.desc: Every status change, price change and edit is recorded with who did it and when.
items.alt: A car's status history and activity log

items.name: Arabic and English

items.alt: The inventory screen in Arabic, laid out right to left

items.name: Works on your phone
items.desc: Add AutoNexa to your home screen and work from the showroom floor, with the screens your team uses most one tap away.
items.alt: The dashboard and bookings screens on two phones

trust.caption: Your data
trust.title: Your dealership’s records stay yours.
trust.body: Each dealership gets its own private workspace. Records are kept apart by the database itself, not only by what the screens show, so another dealership on AutoNexa can’t reach yours.
facts: Records separated at the database level
Access set by role and by branch
An audit log of who changed what
trust.alt: Two dealerships' private workspaces kept apart by a lock, above an audit log of who changed what

visual.wall: Kept apart by the database, not just by the screens

how.caption: How it works
how.title: Follow one car from purchase to sale.
how.intro: This is the whole idea of AutoNexa: one record follows the car through five steps, and each person adds their part.

steps.name: Buy
steps.text: Record the purchase and its documents. A manager approves it.
steps.alt: A car's purchase record with its price and total cost

steps.name: Prepare
steps.text: Receive the car, add expenses and photos, and mark it ready for sale.
steps.alt: The inventory list with cars in transit, ready for sale and booked

steps.name: Price
steps.text: Set the selling and minimum price with the full cost in front of you.
steps.alt: A car's total cost, minimum and target price, and expected profit

steps.name: Book
steps.text: Reserve it for a buyer, take the deposit and let AutoNexa watch the deadline.
steps.alt: The bookings screen on a phone, with what is paid and still to collect

steps.name: Sell
steps.text: Take the final payment, close the sale and see what the car made.
steps.alt: The dashboard on a phone with this month's sales
